stem: The lengths of a random sample of 50 roads in a certain region were measured. Using the results, a 95% confidence interval for the mean length, in metres, of all roads in this region was found to be [245, 263].

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Find the mean length of the 50 roads in the sample.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Calculate an estimate of the standard deviation of the lengths of roads in this region.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
It is now given that the lengths of roads in this region are normally distributed.

State, with a reason, whether this fact would make any difference to your calculation in part **(b)**.
